Contract of Carriage: Domestic General Rules

Last Modified August 18, 2026

RULE 3: DEFINITIONS

"Controllable Cancellation" means a cancellation caused by circumstances within the carrier's control, including maintenance or crew problems, and excluding weather and air traffic control decisions.

RULE 19: FLIGHT DELAYS/CANCELLATIONS

When a flight is cancelled or significantly delayed for reasons within the carrier's control, the carrier will rebook the passenger on the next available flight operated by the carrier at no additional cost to the passenger.

If the delay requires an overnight stay and the cause is within the carrier's control, the carrier will provide hotel accommodation and ground transportation to and from that accommodation.

RULE 20: DENIED BOARDING COMPENSATION

A passenger who is involuntarily denied boarding on an oversold flight is entitled to compensation determined by the length of the delay in arrival at the passenger's final destination, as set out in the following table.

Delay at final destinationDomesticInternational
0 to 1 hour$0$0
1 to 2 hours200% of fare200% of fare
Over 2 hours400% of fare400% of fare

RULE 22: REFUNDS

A passenger is entitled to a refund of the unused portion of the ticket if the carrier cancels the flight and the passenger elects not to accept rebooking.
